text_block_list.text:
One day at lunch break. Walking down the 
hallway, I heard arguing coming from 
Manhattan Cafe and Agnes Tachyon's private 
space.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please, Cafe. There's no guinea—ahem, 
Umamusume more suited for this experiment 
than you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...So no matter what you say, I will not 
cooperate with your research...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Or rather... yesterday... no, I say this 
every time, but... you explain far too 
little...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We don't even know the details... There's 
no way we can help—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is why, look! I went ahead and 
prepared instructions and standard 
procedures!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold, this sheer volume and detailed 
explanations! I even bolded frequently 
used terms— I worked sooo hard on this, 
honestly!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...*sigh*... Very well, show me what 
you've got..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will make a proper judgment... If I 
refuse, please give up as well...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course!

And so, as Manhattan Cafe read through the 
instructions, she had a somewhat solemn 
look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a test to see how stimulation within 
a dream affects running performance, you 
see. An innovative approach utilizing 
lucid dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The method is detailed there as well, but 
put simply, I will intrude into your dream 
and observe your reaction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is a reasonable amount of risk, but 
there is also a possibility of bringing 
about positive results! —That's what it 
says, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Well. Certainly... If things go 
well, it seems we might achieve good 
results.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oops, does that mean... it's a yes?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ As I am now, I still need far 
more strength...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...As I ran race after race... that was 
indeed how I felt..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Trainer... ...I want to hear 
your thoughts..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm challenging this race... together with 
you... I don't want to... make decisions 
all on my own...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
High risk, high return... Should I... 
undergo this experiment...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That's the spirit! Now then, 
let's begin the experiment at once!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...This place is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In a dream, of course! Well, I had 
expected as much, but it's overflowing 
with bizarre structures! What in the world 
is that swirling round thing?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...P-Please don't stare too much... So, 
what's this 'stimulation' you 
mentioned...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"A dream is inherently a private space. 
Having someone else intrude is a major 
stimulus in itself. In other words, 
something is bound to happen without doing 
a thing—"
(Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: âSpeak of the devil...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...A giant... butterfly...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —So beautiful...

A few days after the experiment. As she 
ran across the grounds, her steps felt 
somewhat light, and—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A splendidly positive result. 
Fascinating data! Thank you for your 
cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, likewise...

The experiment seemed to have had a 
positive effect on her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —No, that's not... That's... that's...!
(Gwooooh...!)

A few days after the experiment. As she 
ran across the grounds, her steps felt 
somewhat heavy, and—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer... The creature I 
saw in my dream kept flickering in my 
mind... I couldn't run properly—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, thanks for helping me out the 
other day. Or rather, well, um—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, consider it an apology gift of 
sorts. I brought an energy drink to pick 
you up. Here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, really... ...I'm fine...

This experiment ended up with rather 
unfavorable results for Manhattan Cafe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! Why not?!
choice_data_list: I can't let you put yourself in danger.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, fine. I'll withdraw for now. 
...Your presence is unexpectedly 
troublesome."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. And while I'm at it, I'll hand 
over the test data I gathered using myself 
as the subject. Peruse it as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"So... if you ever change your mind, 
you're welcome to come visit anytime."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of doing it... 
...However, the premise is quite 
interesting...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...If it is her, perhaps one day... she 
truly will discover 'what lies beyond'..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, the contents are far more 
perplexing than I imagined... ......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating, but... As expected, that 
person's intellect is truly something 
special...
